message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a man against a dark purple background. The man, shown from the chest up in profile facing left, has dark hair and tan skin. He wears a white, long-sleeved button-down shirt. His hands are positioned in front of him, gripping a black handgun. The handgun is unusual; its barrel curves upwards and back in a 180-degree "U" shape, with the muzzle pointing directly back at the man's forehead.

In the upper third, large red letters spell "TEMPO." Above this, smaller white text reads "Operasi Penyelamatan Pilot Susi Air H.24" and "Pengaturan Baru Iklan Media Digital H.81." Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small red letters. To the right of the title are publication details, a barcode, and a QR code. Large white text in the center-left reads "KASAK-KUSUK SEBELUM VONIS." Below this is a paragraph in smaller white text beginning with "Ferdy Sambo melakukan pelbagai cara..." and ending with "sebelum vonis mati. H.62." All elements are set against a dark, monochromatic purple field.
